title: Reactive forms: typed controls, groups and arrays

videos.script:
The planner can tick sessions, but it cannot add one. This lesson builds the form that does, and the way Angular wants a form built when it is going to grow.

{{control}} In a reactive form, the form is an object in the class, and the template points at it. You start with one control, and see what a number field puts in it, and what an empty one does.

{{group}} Then a group of two, a date and the minutes. The compiler knows the type of each, and it catches a field that might be missing.

{{submit}} The form sends a session to the server and waits for its answer, because a new session has no id until the server gives it one.

{{builder}} Form builder says the same thing in fewer words.

{{array}} And a form array lets one form plan the same session on several days.

{{typed}} Last, what the types bought, and what older code looks like without them.
